Specification of Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 93 of 173 Document ID 79 : AUTOSAR_SWS_COMManager Channel Cnt Pointer to number of Com M cha nnels that are passed in the Mapping Table parameter. Pnc Cnt Pointer to number of PNCs, that are passed in the Mapping Table parameter. Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: Successfully get PNC - to - channel - mapping entry E_ NOT_ OK: Getting of PNC - to - ch annel - mapping entry failed COMM_ E_ LEARNING_ ACTIVE: Functionality cannot be executed because PNC learning phase is active. Description This function returns the current configuration of the ECUs PNC - to - channel - mapping. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Com M.h
